# Display World — Commercial LED Video Walls & Turnkey Digital Signage

> Display World (Display World Digital Signage LLC) is a premier manufacturer, visual technology innovator, and turnkey AV systems integrator based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. We specialize in ultra-fine pitch LED video walls, COB MicroLED, transparent OLEDs, architectural curved displays, outdoor 3D anamorphic billboards, and 24/7 mission-critical AMC maintenance contracts across the UAE and GCC.

## Core Visual Hardware Capabilities
- **Fine-Pitch Indoor LED Video Walls:** Pixel pitch P0.7mm, P0.9mm, P1.25mm, P1.56mm, P1.87mm, P2.0mm, P2.5mm.
- **COB (Chip-on-Board) & MicroLED:** Flip-chip packaging, dustproof, anti-static, moisture-proof, high contrast ratio (10,000:1), ultra-wide 178° viewing angles.
- **Transparent OLED & Mesh LED:** Up to 70% optical transparency for luxury retail storefronts, automotive showrooms, and architectural glass facades.
- **Curved & Flexible LED Modules:** Convex, concave, 90-degree seamless corner wraparounds, column wraps, and custom ribbon displays.
- **Outdoor 3D Anamorphic Billboards:** High brightness (5,500 to 10,000 nits), IP65/IP68 weather resistance, heat dissipation engineered for Middle East 50°C summer conditions.
- **Interactive Touch Kiosks & Totems:** 4K PCAP and infrared multi-touch (10 to 40 touch points), anti-glare tempered glass, integrated thermal management.
- **Digital Signage CMS Software:** Cloud-based content scheduling, multi-zone splitting, dynamic telemetry, emergency alert overrides, and remote device monitoring.

## Service Offerings & Engineering SLAs
- **Turnkey Integration:** Comprehensive architectural site surveys, structural load calculations, custom bracket engineering, electrical conduit routing, and calibration.
- **Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC):**
  - *Bronze Tier:* 8-hour response, remote telemetry diagnostics, bi-annual preventive maintenance.
  - *Silver Tier (Recommended):* 4-hour on-site dispatch, quarterly deep-tuneups, parts replacement coverage, hotline support.
  - *Gold SLA Tier:* 2-hour 24/7/365 emergency dispatch, monthly preventive site visits, hot-spare parts storage, live screen telemetry monitoring.
